title: Warhost: 48 Army Battles for Godot 4
shortText: Army battles for Godot 4: 48 staged battles, every soldier and banner drawn in code.
html:
Warhost is a Godot 4.7 addon for army battles: 48 staged battles on 12 fields, every soldier, banner and field drawn in code. Royalty free in your games. A free MIT lite with 12 battles is on this page.

Give it two armies as plain data: regiments of foot, pikes, archers, horse and mages, each with a name and a soldier count. Pick a formation and the battle plays out soldier by soldier on a generated battlefield. Volleys arc overhead, spells burst, riders charge, regiments break and run. When it ends, a signal hands every regiment's survivors back to your game.

var battle := WarhostBattle.new()
battle.player_army = [{"name": "Iron Company", "role": "foot", "count": 120}]
battle.enemy_army = [{"name": "Grey Lances", "role": "horse", "count": 40}]
battle.battle_finished.connect(func(result): print(result["winner"]))
add_child(battle)

Every soldier drawn

No image files ship. The soldiers in your two colours, the arrows, the spells and each field's sky, hills and keep are drawn at run time. A host of any size is carried at several soldiers per figure; the result still counts every soldier.

Banners from the regiment's name

Every regiment flies arms generated from its name: tinctures, ordinaries, charges and four flag shapes. The same name flies the same arms every time. A banner leans back when its regiment breaks and falls where its last man falls.

What is inside

  • 48 staged battles on 5 terrains (meadow, steppe, snow, desert, moor), framed wide, at the centre or up close. Each is a preset scene with exported armies, formations, colours and framing.
  • Five arms and four formations (line, wedge, square, loose), each with written rules in the Readme.
  • The war record: winner, steps and every regiment's survived, fled and dead.
  • A demo that browses all 48 with each host's banners and a live bar per regiment.

Both renderers

Every battle is photographed under Forward+ and Compatibility, the web renderer. Godot 4.7.2; older versions were not run.

Free lite and install

Warhost Lite is free (MIT): 12 of the battles, fought with foot and archers. Copy addons/warhost into your project, or open the godot folder and press Play. Read the docs.

Licence

Royalty free in your games, no credit required. No resale or redistribution of the files as a pack.

Made with AI tools: the code was written with AI, and everything it draws is computed by that code.

More from the same studio

  • Warhost for RPG Maker MZ, the same battles as an MZ plugin.
  • Sigilcast for Godot 4, spell seals drawn in code.
  • CSAF Godot 4 Sampler, free presets from our addons.
